 {#sPurati raBasAtpARiH pAdopasaMgrahaRAya ca#} <ls>Mv. 2. 30</ls>.

.²6 Taking, accepting (as a wife); {#dAropasaMgrahaH#} <ls>Y. 1. 56</ls>.
